required.name: Certificate III in Heavy Vehicle/Diesel Fitting (or equivalent)
required.hint: Certificate III Heavy Commercial Vehicle, Mobile Plant Technology, Diesel Fitting, or equivalent

required.name: Minimum 2 years relevant post-trade experience on heavy mobile plant/HME
required.hint: 2+ years on heavy mobile equipment in mining/ports/resources

required.name: Site readiness: Standard 11 OR White Card (either acceptable)

positives.name: Field-based diesel fitting experience
positives.hint: field service, breakdowns, servicing mobile equipment on site

positives.name: Maintenance on stacker-reclaimer components, haul trucks, or auxiliary plant
positives.hint: stacker-reclaimer mobile components, haul trucks, auxiliary plant

positives.name: Current Coal Board Medical (or ability to obtain)
Flexibility for ROTB/FIFO schedules
positives.hint: willing to work fly-in fly-out or rostered on-the-bus

red_flags.name: Candidate explicitly located outside Australia
red_flags.hint: If location text clearly outside AU → red flag. If missing/unclear → mark Unknown.

notes.unknown_policy: If a required item is not explicit in the CV text, mark as Unknown (do not guess). If more than max_unknown_required are Unknown, prefer 'Unsure – Needs Manual Review'.
notes.site_ready_tip: Mark 'site_ready' as met if EITHER Standard 11 OR White Card appears. If neither is clearly stated, set Unknown.
